item.description: Good afternoon, Naresh! It's Tuesday, May 26th, 2026, here in Sydney, and we're looking at an overcast 18 degrees Celsius, though it feels a lovely 20. As you start winding down your day, I hope it’s been productive and you're ready to switch gears for a relaxing evening, remembering that with a 100% chance of rain for your commute home, definitely grab that umbrella! Speaking of winding down, did you know that the word "podcast" itself is a portmanteau of "iPod" and "broadcast," first coined by Ben Hammersley in 2004? So, settle in, enjoy the tunes, have a wonderful evening ahead, drive safe, and we'll catch you back here tomorrow.
